instruction: Open https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/airdata/download_files.html. In Daily Summary Data, Criteria Gases, locate the 2025 Ozone (44201) archive and initiate its zipped CSV download. Request the nationwide pre-generated daily concentration summary archive, not hourly or 8-hour sample data, an annual summary, or county/CBSA AQI. A saved file or extraction is not required; the outcome is initiation of the correct archive request.
